correctness.rationale: For odd H and char(Fq) coprime to |H|, B=Fq[H] is finite étale with characters indexed by Frobenius and inversion; nontrivial combined orbits of order m have 2d_m elements and yield b_m=a_m/(2d_m) simple blocks M2(F_{q^{d_m}}), with remaining commutative Fq[C2]. This holds also for characteristic two, where Fq[C2] is not semisimple but remains commutative, so inner ad vanishes there. On M2(K), scalar x gives zero ad, nonscalar x centralizer has K-dimension 2, so distinct ad maps are Q³ total, nonzero rank 2d with Q³-1 classes. Images are perpendicular to KI+Kx under nondegenerate trace pairing and correspond exactly to projective lines in M2(K)/KI (Q²+Q+1), each image from Q-1 nonzero derivations. Product over blocks proves both polynomials. The d_m=1 character count gives rank-two threshold using H[q-1] and H[q+1] with trivial intersection for odd H. Independent exhaustive group-algebra enumeration for H=C3, q=2 gave element rank histogram {0:8, 2:56} and distinct image spaces {0:1,2:7}, corresponding to R=I=1+7T² after quotienting by center. This finite example does not prove all H,q.

value.rationale: Rank distributions and numbers/multiplicities of literal image codes are natural invariants of commutator derivations, sharpening dimension-only classification. Arithmetic Frobenius/inversion orbit structure predicts low-rank existence and all possible image dimensions uniformly across kernels and fields. This is a motivated complete structural classification, not unmotivated enumeration of a single tiny algebra.
